Nidoqueen

Poison Ground

Kanto · Generation 1

Nidoqueen is a Poison/Ground-type Drill Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 60 kg. It evolves from Nidorina. Its highest base stat is Attack (92), with a base stat total of 505.
